consumesExternalOutput.provenance: The completion precondition (src/spawn.ts:299) reads the file the GENERATED turn-end hook writes, and spawn runs that hook as a child process with spawnSync (src/spawn.ts:232), so red-witness rule (f) binds every witness whose members mutate src/spawn.ts. The capture at witness/captures/spawn-turn-end-hook-record.txt:1 is that hook's real output, taken 2026-09-16 on node v26.6.0 against a hook rendered by src/hooks.ts renderTurnEndHook(): an integer argument exits 0 and writes a two-key JSON record, and a NON-integer argument exits 64, writes nothing and prints "tiphys turn-end hook: expected one integer exit-code argument". HOW THIS WITNESS'S OWN NAMED TEST CONSUMES IT: the test's adapter invokes the real hook as a child AFTER awaiting its payload, and the test checks the record that child wrote against the captured contract. This witness is the C-3 half: spawnTask must not return while the payload it launched is still running, which is the property the sentinel file measures. The two members are the same pair this phase's other await witnesses use, and that is a fact about the defect rather than duplication: one missing await has several consequences, and each consequence is a separate registered behavior with its own named test.
